value.body: A marketing executive helps plan and carry out campaigns that promote a product or service. Consumer brands, agencies, startups and service companies hire them. A day may include coordinating with agencies, running social media or events, tracking campaign numbers and preparing reports.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BBA, B.Com, BA or an MBA in Marketing

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Excel, social media and ad dashboards, analytics tools

items.label: Indian media & entertainment sector size
items.note: Advertising is a large share of this sector's revenue

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join as marketing executives or trainees through campus placement, internships or direct applications. A portfolio of internship work or digital-marketing certificates can help.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Digital marketing basics: social, search and email
Reading campaign data and reporting results
Coordinating with sales, design and agency teams

value.title: At a glance
items: Roles range from field and trade marketing to purely digital work.
Common next roles: brand executive, digital marketing manager, product or brand manager after an MBA.
Targets and campaign deadlines drive the pace of work.

competition.note: BBA graduates in 2023-24 at institutions that reported to AISHE — everyone finishing that degree, not only those entering this role.
competition.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 34 (programme-wise out-turn), Ministry of Education

women.note: Share of women among BBA graduates in 2023-24 — the entry degree, not people already working in this role.
